title: Never Step Outside
hook:
WHAT IF YOU
NEVER GO OUT
description:
A quick look at how staying indoors harms body systems.
#IndoorLife #HealthFacts #ScienceShort
AI-free animation made with code. Not medical advice.

lines.hook: What if you never step outside ever?
lines.b1: Your skin turns pale, missing the sun's warm, golden daily hue.
lines.b2: Your internal clock drifts, making you feel sleepy at midnight every night.
lines.b3: Vitamin D plummets, so bone cells begin to soften and weaken.
lines.b4: Serotonin drops, and your mood flattens, feeling as flat as a pancake.
lines.b5: Your immune cells shrink noticeably, leaving you vulnerable to everyday colds.
lines.end: So, would you ever stay indoors forever?
